author: dully-ja
title: ## Mouse Jump preview window does not respond to mouse clicks in v0.101.2362.0

status.label: Reproducible; targeted fix hypothesis
status.detail: The mirrored-display regression is fully described, but the failing click path still needs maintainer reproduction.

next_action.label: Reproduce Mouse Jump click failure
next_action.reason: Check the reported build and the latest build on the same mirrored-monitor topology before selecting a code correction.

judgment.rationale: The issue gives complete steps, a 100% reproduction report on 0.101.2362.0, an exact three-display topology with one mirrored pair, and a successful 0.100.2 comparison. A sanitized diagnostic subset was already analyzed by the issue-triage workflow. The likely hit-test or coordinate-mapping branch is not confirmed, so use a bounded maintainer reproduction rather than ask for another archive.
evidence: The reporter says Mouse Jump opens with Shift+Alt+A but clicking the preview neither moves the cursor nor dismisses the unresponsive preview on Windows 11 25H2 build 26200.9457.
The reporter states the failure reproduced 100% on 0.101.2362.0 and the same setup worked on 0.100.2.
The display setup is three displays, with Displays 1 and 3 duplicated and Display 2 to their right.
The existing automated triage comment says reproduction is sufficient and a sanitized diagnostic subset was analyzed; the raw archive was discarded.
PreviewWindow.PreviewImage_PointerPressed maps a scaled pointer coordinate to ScreenLayouts and returns without moving the cursor when no screen bounds contain it.
The existing Mouse Jump UI test covers a center click on its test setup, not a mirrored three-display mapping. The handler file is unchanged between tags v0.101.2362.0 and v0.101.2652.0.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on 0.101.2362.0, compare the 0.100.2 control and latest 0.101.2652.0, and record whether pointer hit-testing or cursor placement diverges for the mirrored display.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix or fork implementation covers this report. A repository correction is plausible, but the precise failing input or mapping path is unconfirmed and the current implementation must be reproduced first.

proposed_fixes.title: Resolve Mouse Jump preview clicks on mirrored displays
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis only: the WinUI 3 preview handler's DPI-scaled pointer coordinate may fail the ScreenLayout bounds lookup for the reported duplicated-display topology, taking the no-screen early return before cursor movement.
plan: Replay the reported three-display setup and record whether PreviewImage_PointerPressed receives the click, the scaled pointer coordinate, and the ScreenLayout bounds that contain it.
Compare the failing hit-test and cursor target with the successful 0.100.2 control and the latest supported build to isolate a regression from a fixed release.
If the bounds lookup is the failing branch, make mirrored/duplicated preview regions resolve deterministically to a valid target display while preserving DPI scaling and screen bounds.
Add focused coverage for a click on a mirrored multi-display preview and retain the existing primary-display click regression test.
verification: Repeat the exact 0.101.2362.0 failure and 0.100.2 working comparison on the reported topology.
Run the MouseUtils UITests.Next PreviewClickMovesCursorAndDisableStopsActivation test and add a mirrored-display case that checks cursor movement and preview dismissal.
Retest the current 0.101.2652.0 release to determine whether the old-build regression remains.

confidence.rationale: The issue establishes a strong regression and identifies a concrete pointer-to-screen mapping path, but it does not show whether the event is lost or the bounds lookup rejects the pointer. Maintainer instrumentation and current-build reproduction are needed before selecting the fix.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Jump's preview is responsive on the same setup in 0.100.2 but ignores clicks on 0.101.2362.0 with one mirrored display pair.
known_information: The reporter supplies PowerToys versions 0.101.2362.0 and 0.100.2, Windows 11 25H2 build 26200.9457, the Shift+Alt+A shortcut, and exact reproduction steps.
The setup has three displays: two are duplicated/mirrored and the third is positioned to their right.
The preview opens, but on the failing version clicking does not move the cursor; the issue reports no error or crash.
A public triage comment confirms that the uploaded archive was analyzed from a sanitized subset and that the raw archive was discarded.
inferences: The regression is plausibly in the new WinUI 3 preview click path or display-coordinate mapping, but the report does not establish that the pointer handler misses the click.
Because the handler is unchanged through 0.101.2652.0, testing that release can distinguish a still-current regression from an old-build-only issue.
issue_context.analysis: The original report already provides the evidence package that distinguishes the failure, including a working prior version and a multi-monitor layout. The next useful step is maintainer-side instrumentation around pointer receipt, bounds lookup, and cursor movement; asking the reporter for generic logs would not identify that branch.
initial_investigation: Re-read the complete live issue body, its single automation comment, labels, assignees, and update time immediately before judgment.
Inspected PreviewWindow.PreviewImage_PointerPressed: it logs pointer input, scales coordinates for DPI, finds a containing screen layout, and returns early if no layout contains the point.
Inspected the existing Mouse Jump UI test, which verifies a center click and cursor move but does not cover the reported mirrored-display topology.
Compared the handler at v0.101.2362.0 and v0.101.2652.0; no edit to this file appears between those release tags.
Searched for related issue reports; the matching click behavior has no linked fix or active fork trace.

actions.label: Approve focused Mouse Jump fix investigation
actions.note: Approve a test-first, fork-side investigation of the red coordinate-mapping hypothesis; this does not write to microsoft/PowerToys.

reproduce.title: Compare Mouse Jump preview clicks across reported builds
reproduce.version_requirement: Reproduce on 0.101.2362.0, compare with 0.100.2, and retest the latest 0.101.2652.0 build.
prerequisites: Use Windows 11 25H2 with three displays: duplicate Displays 1 and 3, with Display 2 to their right.
Enable Mouse Jump and use the reported Shift+Alt+A activation shortcut.
Use the same display arrangement and cursor starting position for each version comparison.
setup: Record the display bounds and scaling for the duplicated pair and the third display.
steps: On PowerToys 0.101.2362.0, press Shift+Alt+A and confirm the preview appears.
Click a point within each visible preview display image; record whether the cursor moves and the preview closes.
Repeat on 0.100.2 with the same display layout as the working control.
Repeat on 0.101.2652.0 and record the first build where behavior differs.
For a failing click, record whether PreviewImage_PointerPressed runs and whether the scaled point falls inside any ScreenLayout bounds.
reproduce.expected_result: The 0.101.2362.0 failure should be reproducible against the working 0.100.2 control; the latest-build result and whether failure occurs before hit-testing or during target mapping are recorded without assuming the root cause.
